programs=os.path.join(workspace,'programs'); os.makedirs(programs,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full_rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 9 for v in row)}
    full_cols = {c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h))}
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] == 9 and (r in full_rows or c in full_cols) else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
# Save task implementation.
path=os.path.join(programs,task+'.py')
open(path,'w').write(source)
exec(compile(source,path,'exec'),globals())
